title: Sleepy hamster
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- sleepy hamster -->
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='30' ry='26' fill='#E8A75A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='22' ry='18' fill='#F2C179'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='26' ry='23' fill='#E8A75A'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='24' r='8' fill='#E8A75A'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='24' r='4.5' fill='#F7A8B0'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='24' r='8' fill='#E8A75A'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='24' r='4.5' fill='#F7A8B0'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='48' r='6' fill='#F7A8B0'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='48' r='6' fill='#F7A8B0'/>
  <!-- eyes: closed sleepy arcs -->
  <path d='M36 40 Q41 45 46 40' stroke='#4A2C12' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 40 Q59 45 64 40' stroke='#4A2C12' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='3' ry='2.4' fill='#D96A8A'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 51 Q46 55 43 53' stroke='#8A5A2B' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 51 Q54 55 57 53' stroke='#8A5A2B' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M30 50 L20 48' stroke='#C98A44' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 54 L21 55' stroke='#C98A44' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 50 L80 48' stroke='#C98A44' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 54 L79 55' stroke='#C98A44' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- little paws tucked -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='82' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#F2C179'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='82' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#F2C179'/>
  <!-- zzz -->
  <path d='M74 22 L80 22 L74 30 L80 30' stroke='#9AD0FF' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <path d='M82 12 L87 12 L82 18 L87 18' stroke='#9AD0FF' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
</svg>
